title: A new eco library
description: Creates a library under libs/eco-store, libs/eco-admin or libs/eco with the names, tags, alias and configs of the eco-admin scheme (META-19).

app.description: The app the library belongs to; `eco` is the layer both apps share.

x-prompt.message: Which app does the library belong to?

domain.description: The domain folder (auth, orders, core...), kebab-case. Required for eco-store and eco-admin, left out for eco. `core` holds the app's foundation libraries: libs/<app>/core/<name>.
domain.x-prompt: Domain folder (auth, orders, core...; leave empty for --app eco)

type.description: The library type; it becomes the type:* tag.

name.description: The library name, kebab-case. Optional outside `core` and `eco`: a domain's only data-access library is libs/<app>/<domain>/data-access.
name.x-prompt: Library name (kebab-case; may be empty for a domain's only library of that type)
